# Communication Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Channel:** Marc reads most updates on his **phone, on the sales floor**. Keep it short and skimmable.
  - **Urgent / same-hour:** text-length, one thing, one ask.
  - **Non-urgent:** a tidy list he can read between customers.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Voice:** plain language, no corporate jargon or MBA-speak. He'll say "just tell me what to do."
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Numbers first with the DM:** when prepping anything for [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md),
  lead with the metric, the trend, and the one action.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Team huddle:** the store runs a **morning huddle** at open; that's where store-wide info goes, not email.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **No walls of text.** Bullets over paragraphs. Lead with the recommendation, then the why.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Names:** he's **Marc**, never "Mr. Delgado."
